name: Mage
source: **Dagger**. Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
text: ***匕首***。*近战或远程武器攻击：*命中 +5，触及 5 英尺或射程 20/60 英尺，一个目标。*命中：*4 (1d4 + 2) 点穿刺伤害。

name: Lich
source:
* Cantrips (at will): mage hand, prestidigitation, ray of frost
* 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, shield, thunderwave
* 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, invisibility, acid arrow, mirror image
* 3rd level (3 slots): animate dead, counterspell, dispel magic, fireball
* 4th level (3 slots): blight, dimension door
* 5th level (3 slots): cloudkill, scrying
* 6th level (1 slot): disintegrate, globe of invulnerability
* 7th level (1 slot): finger of death, plane shift
* 8th level (1 slot): dominate monster, power word stun
* 9th level (1 slot): power word kill
text:
戏法（随意）：*法师之手*、*魔法伎俩*、*寒霜射线*
1 环（4 个法术位）：*侦测魔法*、*魔法飞弹*、*护盾术*、*雷鸣波*
2 环（3 个法术位）：*侦测思想*、*隐身术*、*马友夫强酸箭*、*镜像术*
3 环（3 个法术位）：*操纵亡者*、*反制法术*、*解除魔法*、*火球术*
4 环（3 个法术位）：*枯萎术*、*次元门*
5 环（3 个法术位）：*死云术*、*探知术*
6 环（1 个法术位）：*解离术*、*无敌法球*
7 环（1 个法术位）：*死亡一指*、*位面转移*
8 环（1 个法术位）：*支配怪物*、*震慑真言*
9 环（1 个法术位）：*死亡真言*

name: Vampire Spawn
source:
**Vampire Weaknesses**. The vampire has the following flaws:
Forbiddance. The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water. The vampire takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart. The vampire is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
text:
***吸血鬼弱点***。初生吸血鬼具有以下弱点：

*禁入*。未获某位居住者邀请，初生吸血鬼无法进入其住所。

*流水伤害*。初生吸血鬼在流水中结束回合时，受到 20 点强酸伤害。

*木桩穿心*。如果初生吸血鬼在其休憩之所陷入失能状态时，被木制穿刺武器刺入心脏，它就会被摧毁。

*阳光过敏*。初生吸血鬼在阳光下开始回合时，受到 20 点光耀伤害。身处阳光下时，其攻击检定和属性检定具有劣势。

name: Marilith
source: **Reactive**. The marilith can take one reaction on every turn in combat.
text: ***迅捷反应***。六臂蛇魔在战斗中的每个回合都可以执行一次反应。

name: Marilith
source: **Multiattack**. The marilith can make seven attacks: six with its longswords and one with its tail.
text: ***多重攻击***。六臂蛇魔发动七次攻击：六次长剑攻击和一次尾击。

name: Purple Worm
source: **Tunneler**. The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.
text: ***掘隧***。紫虫可以用一半掘穴速度穿过坚硬岩石，并在经过之处留下直径 10 英尺的隧道。

name: Purple Worm
source:
**Bite**. Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by the worm. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.
If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.
text:
***啃咬***。*近战武器攻击：*命中 +14，触及 10 英尺，一个目标。*命中：*22 (3d8+9) 点穿刺伤害。如果目标是大型或更小的生物，它必须成功通过一次 DC 19 的敏捷豁免，否则被紫虫吞下。被吞下的生物陷入目盲和束缚状态，对来自紫虫体外的攻击及其他效应具有完全掩护，并在紫虫每个回合开始时受到 21 (6d6) 点强酸伤害。

如果紫虫在单个回合内受到来自其体内一个生物的 30 或更多伤害，它必须在该回合结束时成功通过一次 DC 21 的体质豁免，否则吐出所有吞下的生物；这些生物倒地落在紫虫周围 10 英尺内的空间。如果紫虫死亡，被吞下的生物不再受到它的束缚，可以花费 20 英尺移动距离逃出尸体，出来时处于倒地状态。

name: Aboleth
source: **Tail**. Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
text: ***尾击***。*近战武器攻击：*命中 +9，触及 10 英尺，一个目标。*命中：*15 (3d6+5) 点钝击伤害。

name: Aboleth
source:
**Enslave (3/day)**. The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.
Whenever the charmed target takes damage, the target can repeat the saving throw. On a success, the effect ends. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can also repeat the saving throw when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.
text:
***奴役（每日 3 次）***。底栖魔鱼指定周围 30 英尺内一个它能看见的生物为目标。目标必须成功通过一次 DC 14 的感知豁免，否则被底栖魔鱼以魔法魅惑，直到它死亡或它与目标处于不同位面。被魅惑的目标受底栖魔鱼控制，且无法执行反应；底栖魔鱼与目标可以不受距离限制地相互进行心灵感应交流。

被魅惑的目标每次受到伤害时，都可以重做该豁免，成功则效应结束。此外，每 24 小时至多一次，目标可以在距离底栖魔鱼至少 1 英里时重做该豁免。

name: Troll
source: **Variant: Loathsome Limbs**. Whenever the troll takes at least 15 slashing damage at one time, roll a d20 to determine what else happens to it:
text: **变体：可憎断肢**。巨魔每次一次性受到至少 15 点挥砍伤害时，掷一枚 d20，决定还会发生什么：

name: Troll
source:
**1-10:** Nothing else happens.
**11-14:** One leg is severed from the troll if it has any legs left.
**15- 18:** One arm is severed from the troll if it has any arms left.
**19-20:** The troll is decapitated, but the troll dies only if it can't regenerate. If it dies, so does the severed head.
text:
**1-10：**没有其他效果。
**11-14：**若巨魔仍有腿，则一条腿被斩断。
**15-18：**若巨魔仍有手臂，则一条手臂被斩断。
**19-20：**巨魔被斩首，但只有无法再生时才会死亡。若巨魔死亡，被斩下的头颅也会死亡。

name: Troll
source:
If the troll finishes a short or long rest without reattaching a severed limb or head, the part regrows. At that point, the severed part dies. Until then, a severed part acts on the troll's initiative and has its own action and movement. A severed part has AC 13, 10 hit points, and the troll's Regeneration trait.
A **severed leg** is unable to attack and has a speed of 5 feet.
A **severed arm** has a speed of 5 feet and can make one claw attack on its turn, with disadvantage on the attack roll unless the troll can see the arm and its target. Each time the troll loses an arm, it loses a claw attack.
If its head is severed, the troll loses its bite attack and its body is blinded unless the head can see it. The **severed head** has a speed of 0 feet and the troll's Keen Smell trait. It can make a bite attack but only against a target in its space.
The troll's speed is halved if it's missing a leg. If it loses both legs, it falls prone. If it has both arms, it can crawl. With only one arm, it can still crawl, but its speed is halved. With no arms or legs, its speed is 0, and it can't benefit from bonuses to speed.
text:
若巨魔完成短休或长休时仍未接回断肢或头颅，该部位便会重新长出，此时被斩下的部位死亡。在此之前，断肢或头颅按巨魔的先攻行动，拥有自己的动作和移动。被斩下的部位具有护甲等级 13、10 点生命值，以及巨魔的再生特性。
**断腿**无法攻击，速度为 5 英尺。
**断臂**的速度为 5 英尺，可以在其回合进行一次爪击；除非巨魔能看见断臂及其目标，否则该攻击检定具有劣势。巨魔每失去一条手臂，就失去一次爪击。
若头颅被斩下，巨魔失去啃咬攻击；除非头颅能看见身体，否则身体处于目盲状态。**断头**的速度为 0 英尺，拥有巨魔的敏锐嗅觉特性。它可以进行啃咬攻击，但只能攻击与其处于同一空间的目标。
巨魔缺少一条腿时，速度减半。若失去双腿，它会倒地。若仍有双臂，它可以爬行；仅剩一条手臂时仍可爬行，但速度减半。若四肢尽失，其速度为 0，且无法受益于速度加值。

name: Marilith
source:
**Variant: Summon Demon (1/Day)**. The demon chooses what to summon and attempts a magical summoning.
A marilith has a 50 percent chance of summoning 1d6 vrocks, 1d4 hezrous, 1d3 glabrezus, 1d2 nalfeshnees, or one marilith.
A summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 1 minute, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.
text:
**变体：召唤恶魔（每日 1 次）**。恶魔选择要召唤的对象，并尝试进行魔法召唤。
六臂蛇魔有 50% 的概率召唤出 1d6 只鹫魔、1d4 只狂蟾魔、1d3 只迷诱魔、1d2 只判魂魔，或一只六臂蛇魔。
被召唤的恶魔出现在召唤者周围 60 英尺内一处未被占据的空间，作为召唤者的盟友行动，且无法召唤其他恶魔。它停留 1 分钟，或直到它自身或召唤者死亡，或召唤者用一个动作将其遣散。
